expectations.text: Slide titles, hooks, and bullets are written in natural Hindi, not left in English or stiffly translated.
expectations.evidence: e.g. 'मजबूत शुरुआत — 30 दिनों में 12,000 डाउनलोड एक अच्छा संकेत है' reads as natural Hindi, not a literal translation.

expectations.text: Uses a theme with a Devanagari-capable font rather than the Latin-only presets.
expectations.evidence: Executor's summary confirms 'Nirmala UI' was explicitly set on all Hindi text runs.

expectations.text: The two numbers (12,000 downloads, 4.3 rating) appear as a clear KPI-style callout.
expectations.evidence: Slide 3 has two large stat-card-style callouts: '12,000 | कुल डाउनलोड' and '4.3 ★ | औसत यूज़र रेटिंग'.

expectations.text: The deck is short per the explicit 'not too long, just the main points' request.
expectations.evidence: 5 slides (title, background, metrics, what-it-means, thank-you) - still short overall and not padded with invented content, but noticeably less tight than the with-skill run's 3-slide version of the same brief; the extra background/meaning slides restate given facts rather than add new ones, so this is a borderline pass rather than a clean one.
